terrain.plains.name: Plains
terrain.plains.desc: Open ground. Easy going, no cover.
terrain.forest.name: Forest
terrain.forest.desc: Slows vehicles, blunts attacks. Good cover.
terrain.hills.name: Hills
terrain.hills.desc: High ground: strong defense, slower advance.
terrain.mountains.name: Mountains
terrain.mountains.desc: Impassable for vehicles. Infantry only, very slow.
terrain.city.name: Town
terrain.city.desc: Strong cover. Capturable objective — garrison it with infantry or scouts.
terrain.bridge.name: Bridge
terrain.bridge.desc: The only crossing over open water. No cover — expect fire.
terrain.water.name: Open water
terrain.void.name: Off-map
units.infantry.name: Rifle Squad
units.infantry.role: Frontline holder — cheap, tough in cover
units.infantry.desc: Slow but stubborn. Rifle Squads defend towns and hills well and are the only dependable objective takers. Weak against armor in the open.
units.recon.name: Outrider Car
units.recon.role: Fast scout — grabs objectives, hunts guns
units.recon.desc: Fastest unit on the board. Outriders seize distant objectives and shred artillery in melee range, but wilt in a straight fight.
units.armor.name: Vanguard Tank
units.armor.desc: The spearhead. Vanguards crush infantry and guns in the open and counter hard, but bog down in forests and cannot climb mountains. Cannot capture objectives.
units.artillery.name: Bombard Gun
units.artillery.desc: Bombards shell targets at range with no fear of counters, but are defenseless if an enemy closes adjacent. Fragile — keep an escort nearby.
ai.standard.name: Measured
ai.aggressive.name: Relentless
scenarios.bootcamp.name: First Contact
scenarios.bootcamp.brief: A quiet sector, a green task force, and two farm towns between you and the enemy vanguard.
scenarios.bootcamp.intro: Karsite scouts crossed the Meridian Line overnight. Push them out of both towns before they dig in.
scenarios.bootcamp.outro: The villages are ours. The Federation has its answer — and its first veterans.
scenarios.crossing.name: The Meridian Crossing
scenarios.crossing.brief: Two bridges span the Vel. Everything you need is on the far bank.
scenarios.crossing.intro: Bridgehead first, breakout second. Take the Northbank town and the eastern mill — the bridges are death without cover.
scenarios.crossing.outro: The crossing holds. The road to the interior lies open.
scenarios.hill214.name: Hill 214
scenarios.hill214.brief: A fortified ridge commands the mountain pass. Take the high ground.
scenarios.hill214.intro: The Karsites dug into the ridge lines. Vehicles will struggle uphill — bring your guns and infantry, and take the waystation on the slope.
scenarios.hill214.outro: Hill 214 flies Federation colors. Their line of sight is broken.
scenarios.rustfields.name: The Rustfields
scenarios.rustfields.brief: Open farmland — a tank country duel against a relentless commander.
scenarios.rustfields.intro: No rivers, no ridges: just grain, rust and armor. Take the silo and both crossroads depots before they do.
scenarios.rustfields.outro: Their spearheads burn among the grain. The field is ours.
scenarios.gate.name: The Velmora Gate
scenarios.gate.brief: The capital's gate district. Win here and the invasion dies here.
scenarios.gate.intro: Hold your barracks in the south, then carry the fight into the Gate Quarter and the North Battery. Every district matters.
scenarios.gate.outro: The Gate Quarter falls. The Union army retreats across the Meridian — the campaign is won.
tut.welcome: Welcome, General. This guided battle teaches the basics, one step at a time. Your goal: capture both marked towns.
tut.select: Step 1 — Click your Vanguard Tank (or use the arrow keys to move the cursor and press Enter). Selected units show where they can move.
tut.move: Step 2 — Click a lit tile to move. Forest slows vehicles; plains cost 1. Invalid tiles simply do not light up.
tut.attack: Step 3 — Attack: click an enemy in range (red ring). The forecast shows damage before you commit. Tanks hit hard — but watch for return fire.
tut.capture: Step 4 — Capture: end a Rifle Squad's move ON a town tile to raise your flag. Only infantry and scouts can capture.
tut.end: Step 5 — Press End turn (E) when every unit is done. The Karsites then move — their actions appear in the log.
tut.won: Battle won! Survivors become your permanent force. On the campaign screen you will spend prestige on repairs, training and reinforcements.
settings.title: Settings
settings.reduceMotionDesc: Skips movement and combat animations. Useful for motion sensitivity and faster play.
settings.languageHint: English is bundled. See docs/CONTENT-GUIDE.md to add another locale in minutes.
help.title: How to play
help.goalBody: Capture every marked objective, or destroy every Karsite unit, before the turn limit runs out. Between battles you manage one small task force that carries on from battle to battle.
help.turnBody: Each unit may move once and attack once, in either order. Attacking ends the unit's turn. When you are done, press End turn and the enemy moves.
help.combatBody: Damage depends on the attacker's strength, class matchups, distance and the defender's terrain cover. Defenders hit back unless destroyed, suppressed, or out of range — artillery cannot answer adjacent attackers.
help.terrainBody: Hover or click any tile to see its move costs and cover. Towns are objectives: capture them with infantry or scouts.
help.keys.move: Arrow keys / WASD — move the map cursor
help.keys.select: Enter / Space — select, confirm move, attack
help.keys.next: Tab — jump to the next unit with actions left
credits.title: Credits & Licenses
credits.conceptBody: Iron Meridian is an original game. Its code, text, maps, factions, setting, artwork and sounds were created for this project. It is inspired only by the broad genre ideas of classic turn-based wargames; no third-party code, data, maps or art are used.
credits.codeBody: All game code is original, written for this project and MIT licensed. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui — see the repository LICENSES.md for the full dependency list.
credits.assetsBody: Illustrations, terrain tiles, unit art and emblems are AI-generated originals created for this game (see public/assets/img/ASSETS.md). Sound effects are synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API — no samples.
credits.thirdPartyBody: No LGeneral or Panzer General code, data, artwork or branding is included or derived from.
